name: Diamond of Jungle

features.name: Super Free Spins
features.description: Bought mode with 2x–25x multipliers on wins.

review:
A comic-book jungle on 243 ways – gorillas, tigers, elephants and toucans. Unusually, you can switch the volatility yourself between modes, which is great if you're still working out what volatility feels like.

Diamond scatters trigger free spins where random wins are multiplied by 2x to 10x, and there's a Super Free Spins buy that multiplies wins by 2x to 25x. 1,500x max and a 97.01% RTP; BGaming's info is inconsistent on volatility, so we haven't labelled it. Free spins about once every 123 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.01% RTP – among the highest published
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 123 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
